text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/**'

jobs:
  generate-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Flutter
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        channel: stable
        flutter-version: 2.5.3

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: flutter pub get

    - name: Activate intl_utils
      run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

    - name: Generate translations
      run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

    - name: Create PR
      id: create-pr
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        commit-message: "chore: regenerate translations"
        title: "Regenerate translations"
        body: "This PR was automatically created by the GitHub Actions workflow to regenerate translations."
        branch: regenerate-translations
```
